sloka: लङ्कामुपनिविष्टश्च रामो दशरथात्मजः ।लक्ष्मणानुचरो वीरः पुरीं रावणपालिताम् ।उत्तरद्वारमासाद्य यत्र तिष्ठति रावणः ।। ६.४१.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: laṅkāmupaniviṣṭaśca rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ ।lakṣmaṇānucaro vīraḥ purīṁ rāvaṇapālitām ।uttaradvāramāsādya yatra tiṣṭhati rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.41.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Accompanied by his brother Lakshmana, Rama, armed with bow, blocked the northern gate of Lanka which was like a lofty mountain peak and protected.
